title: Mutariri weMurazvo Usingadzimwi
intro: Munhu anomira pamusuwo wenzvimbo inotyisa zvikuru munzvimbo isingaonekwe, akapiwa basa risingadiwi nemumwe munhu. Mweya inotambura painochema ichikumbira ngoni, mhinduro yakasimba inonzwika mumakamuri emoto. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena kuti ndiani muchengeti uyu asingaperi?
clues: Ndinomira pamusuwo wenzvimbo inotyisa yekurangwa munzvimbo isingaonekwe.
Moto unopfuta, usingadzimwi ndiwo musimboti webasa rangu guru.
Mweya inotambura inodana zita rangu, ichikumbira zororo kubva mukutambudzwa kwayo kusingaperi.
Handisi munhu, kana jinn — ndiri chisikwa chakasikwa chinoteerera Mwari.
Ndini ngirozi huru yakagadzwa semuchengeti wekusingaperi weGehena.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Vanhu veGehena vanokumbira kuti kutambudzwa kwavo kugumiswe
Muprofita anokandwa mumoto mukuru nevanhu vake
Rusvingo rwakasimba rwakavakwa kuti rudzivirire rudzi rwakaora
trial.answer: Vanhu veGehena vanokumbira kuti kutambudzwa kwavo kugumiswe

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Vagari veGehena vanoudzwa kuti vacharamba varipo nekusingaperi
Vagari veGehena vanopiwa mukana wechipiri wekutenda
outcome.answer: Vagari veGehena vanoudzwa kuti vacharamba varipo nekusingaperi

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
